query:
UPDATE users
                SET name = $2,
                    locale = $3,
                    email_verified_at = $4,
                    phone_verified_at = $5,
                    updated_at = $6,
                    email = $7,
                    password_hash = $8,
                    pending_email = $9,
                    password_changed_at = $10,
                    disabled_at = $11,
                    deleted_at = $12
                WHERE id = $1
